items.title: Ireland men set for maiden tour of Pakistan next month, to play three ODIs
items.description:
The Ireland men’s team will tour Pakistan next month for the first time to play three One-day Internationals against the hosts, the cricket boards of both countries announced on Thursday.
The visitors, according to the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB), are scheduled to arrive in the country on January 9, and will take on national developmental side Pakistan Shaheens for three warm-up one-day matches between January 13 and 17.

items.title: Security forces kill 12 India-sponsored terrorists in multiple IBOs in Balochistan: ISPR
items.description:
Security forces killed 12 India-sponsored terrorists in four separate intelligence-based operations (IBOs) in Balochistan between November 20 and 23, the military’s media wing said on Thursday.
According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), security forces targeted a terrorist hideout in Nushki district on November 20.
